comment: A course scheduled within a specific term, with a curriculum type (e.g. Mandatory, Optional) for that term.

columns.name: campus_id
columns.comment: Campus this term course belongs to.

columns.name: term_id
columns.comment: Term this course is scheduled into.

columns.name: course_id
columns.comment: Course being scheduled. Unique together with campus_id and term_id: the same course can't be scheduled twice into the same term.

columns.name: curriculum_type
columns.comment: Whether this course is mandatory or optional within the term -- references curriculum_type.code.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the term course, auto-generated by the database and unique across the whole system.
